name: Stablecoin ETH-share rotation confirmed by TVL -> ETH deployment long (dual on-chain)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the bare ETH-share momentum variant: this demands the rotation be CONFIRMED by defi_tvl rising — i.e. the stablecoins arriving on ETH are actually being DEPLOYED into protocols, not just parked — which filters the 'stables migrated to ETH but sat idle in wallets' false rotation): the edge is where end-demand forms, and deployment is the proof of demand. Requiring stablecoin_eth_share up AND defi_tvl up captures the rotation that has already begun converting into on-chain activity, a stronger nowcast of ETH demand than share alone. Long ETH; exit on TVL rolling over or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if adding the TVL confirm does not improve DSR over the bare-share variant (16), the second leg is redundant. DISCONFIRMER 2: TVL is partly ETH-denominated so its rise can be beta -> if the pair is just tracking ETH price with a lag it dies. DISCONFIRMER 3: both features have short/revised history -> KILL if the edge leans on revised data. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: stablecoins rotating onto ETH AND being deployed into protocols
